left.onPress: if any answer given: confirm 'Discard this?' else close

rules: One question per turn, short, friendly, lowercase-leaning, no jargon
Show typing dots ~450ms before each app message (skip when reduce motion is on)
User answer appears as a right-aligned bubble; selecting an avatar or colour shows it as a small visual bubble
Tap any earlier answer bubble to change it; the flow rewinds to that step and keeps later answers that are still valid
Optional steps always show a 'Skip' quick chip
Never ask for something that can be defaulted
Final step is a summary card inside the chat with Confirm button and 'Change something' chip
Draft answers are held in memory only; closing discards them
Haptic light on each answer; success haptic on confirm

colorSwatch.dock: wrap grid of swatchPicker over projectPalette
colorSwatch.liveEffect: user bubble colour and a mini hero preview update instantly

avatar.dock: opens inline avatar grid (Animals | Plants tabs) with Shuffle

date.dock: quickChips + 'Pick date' opening native date picker

time.dock: quickChips + 'Pick time' opening native time picker

money.dock: large amount display with currency + numeric keypad (0-9, ., backspace) + optional quick chips
money.storage: convert to minor units; no floats

paste.dock: large multiline box + 'Paste from clipboard' button + Skip chip + send

attach.dock: three buttons: Photo, Camera, File + Skip chip + Done once items added

newProject.title: New project

steps.app: hi! let's start a new project.

steps.card: mini hero in chosen colour with name and target date
steps.onConfirm: insert project + activity log; close; open Project Detail; toast 'project created'

newProject.firstRun: intro text becomes 'hi! let's set up your first project.'

newItem.title: New item

steps.card: avatar on project tint, title, due, cost
steps.onConfirm: transaction: insert item + activity log + schedule reminder; close; toast 'added'

newItem.note: Conditional steps are skipped, so a simple item is title, buddy, due, cost, nudge.

steps.warnIf: amount > outstanding: 'that's {x} over what's owed, ok?' (allowed)

steps.duplicateWarning: if identical text (trimmed, whitespace collapsed) exists on another recorded payment: 'looks like you've pasted this one before. save anyway?'

steps.storage: copy to app-private evidence/<paymentId>/, record sha256, mime, size

steps.card: amount, method, date, message preview (2 lines), evidence thumbs, new balance
steps.onConfirm: single transaction: payment + evidence rows + activity log; copy files before commit and clean up on failure; toast 'payment saved'

editMode: Edit actions open compact flat sheets with all fields on one page; ChatForm is only for creating.

a11y.inputFocus: focus moves to the dock input on each step
a11y.keyboardOrder: chips and buttons reachable in order
